description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing the 'BuzzPhotoController' behavior after deleting a photo. It verifies correct handling of cache invalidation and response status when attempting to access a deleted photo.

classes.name: BuzzPhotoControllerAfterDeletePhotoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class testing the behavior of BuzzPhotoController after a photo is deleted, focusing on cache state and response codes.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by populating test data from a YAML fixture file.

methods.name: testHandle
methods.description: Performs the test by setting cache, deleting a photo entity, then calling the controller's handle method and asserting the response status code is 400.
